title: Keep comparison, subset and historical evidence boundaries visible
preconditions: Use committed fixture code, an accepted linked criterion and an inventory-format-2 selected subset.

steps.action: Change code while the saved reference still matches the comparison base.
steps.expected_result: The matching base does not hide HEAD staleness in references, health or reconciliation.

steps.action: Change containing inventory evidence outside the selected bytes.
steps.expected_result: The saved subset stays unchanged while its owning whiteboard element remains stale and counts against health.

steps.action: Revise the linked criterion while code is unchanged, then explicitly publish the updated criterion pin.
steps.expected_result: The old criterion link is stale until the new complete board revision names the reassessed story revision.

steps.action: Publish a successor, reopen the exact old revision through history, and list current references.
steps.expected_result: History opens its original code; the shared reference list contains only the current head rather than duplicate historical evidence.

expected_result: All defined steps retain exact context, report currency honestly and respect native element ownership.
